sheen.$description: Strength of the white sheen over the top of a solid control (SJButton). Used as a color-mix percentage; label contrast is checked against the sheened fill.

soft-ring.$description: Strength of the 1px inner ring on a soft control (SJButton), mixed from the label color. A color-mix percentage.

sheen-stop.$description: Where the sheen of a solid control fades out, measured from the top (SJButton).
